notes: All three Guy B4 questions answered: smallest odd pair coprime to 3 is (5480828320492525, 5786392931193875); smallest odd pair with exactly one member divisible by 3 is (445953248528881275, 659008669204392325), whose members have smallest primes 3 and 5. Minimality from Chernykh's list, complete below 10^20. Corrects the 2026-11-06 entry, which gave a 32-digit pair (proved in Lean) as the answer and left minimality and questions 2-3 open. Outside Lean: the 16- and 18-digit pairs (PARI-checked) and their minimality.
